1.

Still, sweet, wondrous, Flows forth a clear spring, The warm beat of the Father’s heart Drives the stream day by day. Far hidden the spring lay, Yet still its fresh wave Broke its way to the fallen, Poured peace in their hearts.

2.

The thirsty may drink there, It imparts life to the dead. Heavenly healing and comfort It gives to the broken breast. If thou art thirsty, come today, Drink in deep, full draughts! Thou shalt find even here, How sweet the Lord is.

3.

And each one who has drunk Of that wondrous spring, Shall in the land of glory Dwell by the spring’s very edge. There thou shalt see no tears, There thou shalt thirst no more, There thou shalt drink eternally Of that spring’s rich flow.
